_doc: What visibly leaves, rests on the board or changes on a mech, keyed so new content plugs in.
Read by src/render/mechs/visible_parts.gd. Everything shown is driven by GameState and engine
events (deployed, recalled, destroyed, equipment_destroyed, heat_changed); this table only says
what it LOOKS like and where on the body it comes from. Nothing here changes a rule.
types: the default look for a deployable by its lancer-data type.
deployables: by deployable name (the deployed unit's public name). look = a DeployableBuilder
look; dock = the slot it rides on while it is part of the mech (back_r/back_l/shoulder_r/
shoulder_l/torso, or weapon:<id> when the weapon itself is what deploys); launch = fly (it flies
out under its own power) or throw (lobbed in an arc); color = primary/secondary/trim/glow or hex.
frames: first_person = cockpit (default) or body (no cockpit: you see your own remaining body).
weapons_by_tag: what a weapon tag does to the weapon on the body.
equipment: what a destroyed mount/system looks like.

Guardian OROCHI Drone.source: frames: Hydra (OROCHI drones; recall integrates the drone into your mech's body)

mf_hydra.note: The OROCHI drones are part of the Hydra's body: deployed drones leave visible gaps, and in first person you see what is left of you.

mf_lancaster.note: Core system Latch Drone clamps onto an allied mech for the scene (frames: Lancaster). Shown on the ally named by counters.latched_to once the engine records it; until then nothing is shown.

mf_balor.note: Core power Hellswarm: a cloak of nanite drones around the Balor while counters.core_active is set (frames: Balor).

tg_thrown.note: Thrown X (tags: Thrown): the weapon comes to rest next to its target and must be retrieved. Shown from state when the engine tracks it: counters.weapons[key].thrown_at = [x, y, level] hides it on the body and lays it on the board; events weapon_thrown / weapon_retrieved / weapon_returned fly it.
